dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project was to determine the prevalence (percentage of diseased animals in the sampled population) and intensity of infection with Besnoitia tarandi within different herds of caribou in the circumpolar region. Presence and intensity of the disease will be analyzed according to additionnal data collected (i.e. age, body condition, season, year) in order to evaluate the factors influencing this disease. Caribou samples are collected by various contributors of the CircumArctic Rangifer Monitoring and Assessment (CARMA) Network and sent to the Centre Qubcois sur la sant des animaux sauvages (CQSAS) of l'universit de Montral based in St-Hyacinthe for further analysis
dct_subject_sm: Natural sciences -> Leaf River caribou herd
Natural sciences -> George River caribou herd
dct_title_s: The ecology of Besnoitia tarandi in caribou (Rangifer tarandus) within different herds of caribou in the circumpolar region. September 2007-2009
